text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Mile CS with King-san... has 
concluded! Basking in her sheer 
determination, I've fallen even more in 
love-of-loves with Uma Musumes.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She said it herself! "Compete with many 
Umamusume and become a true 
all-rounder"...! Yes, received these words 
of pure gold, yesss!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I decided to run in a ton of big races. 
And at the end of those fierce battles, 
I'm going to challenge Opera O-san and 
Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Next Episode: 《The Warrior's Journey 
Begins!》 Training arc, let's goooo!
